purpose: Say that an experience first made something possible or clear.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Only after becoming a parent did I understand my mother’s hardships.
You appreciate its convenience only after using it.
Only after living alone did I learn how demanding housework is.
restrictions: The first event is the necessary turning point for the realization or change.
mistake: This is more than doing something for the first time; the second clause explains what became clear.
